assumptions.choice: Use the fixed-size alternative through plain self.buy() and self.sell() without a size argument.
assumptions.reason: The specification permits fixed or volatility-based sizing but does not define risk_per_trade; the canonical default therefore applies.

assumptions.choice: Fix each stop-loss at two times ATR(14) measured on the signal bar that submitted the entry order.
assumptions.reason: The specification gives a stop distance but does not state that it trails or is recalculated after entry.

assumptions.choice: Treat an upward cross as prior value strictly below and current value at or above the threshold/band; treat a downward cross symmetrically.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal implementation of crossing from below upward or from above downward.

assumptions.choice: Use the opposite Bollinger/RSI signal without requiring the volume or volatility entry filters.
assumptions.reason: The filters are stated for entries, while the exit rule separately refers to an opposite signal.

assumptions.choice: Exit when 20 bars have elapsed after the entry-fill bar.
assumptions.reason: The specification does not define whether the fill bar itself counts toward the 20-bar holding period.
